Onboarding help center intro: This section describes the typical Humano signup flow. The order and screens may vary depending on active modules and server configuration (for example, whether paid registration is required or your team is exempt).
Onboarding step 1 body_html: Open /register on your Humano site. Enter name, email and password, and accept the terms if prompted. Your user account and an initial team are created.
Onboarding step 2 body: After signing in, review your team name, profile and team settings. Complete company, billing or tax details only if the application asks for them according to your plan and modules.
Onboarding step 3 body_html: Follow the on-screen steps to pay with Stripe and unlock full access. You may be sent to /registration/billing when the app shows that step.
Onboarding step 4 body: With the local connector and prerequisites met, /registration/onboarding/qr is often shown: on your phone open WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device → scan the QR on screen. With Cloud or Twilio, linking is usually done from Chat and provider settings; a QR may not appear on that onboarding page.
Onboarding step 5 body: Open the dashboard and Chat to confirm messages and settings behave as expected.
